finding: Al-Tabari states his own preference for reading al-Kawthar as the name of the river granted to the Messenger in Paradise, then gives successive reports from the Messenger as the reason. This direct commentator statement is distinct from the competing reported interpretation in T05 and from the hadith reports introduced in the next section.

claim.statement_en: Tabari prefers the river interpretation, citing successive reports from Muhammad as his reason.
claim.translation_proposal: Research rendering only: Of these views, the soundest in my view is that al-Kawthar is the name of the river granted to the Messenger in Paradise; God described it as abundant because of its great worth. This view is preferable because reports from the Messenger follow one another confirming it.
